changelog:
- New menu design with two layouts (Appearance): Cards, where a feature's options slide in from the right, or Sidebar
- The menu and every HUD now follow your screen size automatically (Interface size: Auto), and the menu has a soft gradient in your theme's color
- New Lobby cards: a card game for up to 4 friends in any lobby, on a 3D table in front of you with its own HUD. Works without Voice, and leaving the lobby ends your game
- New Soundboard wheel: hold your soundboard key, aim at a sound with the mouse while you keep walking, scroll for more pages
- New Vanilla tab: your stats in the game's own tab list, every column lined up with its name on top (Health too)
- Overlay / Tab stats has a Mode tab (overlay on screen or tab list), Columns and Teams tabs, and the mode always shows at the top. Options the Vanilla tab can't use are hidden
- Blacklists and Denicker now have their own cards
- Player stats (/sc, blacklists, mentions, party requests) are a new kind on the Alerts page: pop-up or chat
- Mentions and party requests can show their stats in the overlay, in chat or as a pop-up
- Stats in chat now say "Blacklisted: CF, H", and hovering a tag shows its list and reason
- Auto reply: write your own reply ({player} becomes their name), and it now answers when someone greets several people at once
- Changing a feature that has a HUD shows that HUD for a moment
- Windows Defender exclusion button in Settings
- Cosmetics: a new preview with your own skin, and trail previews that run
- Cosmetics: your outline now fits your Lunar nametag automatically (badge included) and hides while you emote
- Cosmetics: "at feet" cosmetics only hide while you fly, not when you jump
- "Effects" are now called Cosmetics, the Zeachify logo in the tab list is always on, and your own nametag in third person is off by default
- Voice: talk to your party automatically when one forms, and the Voice HUD only lists who you're talking to
- Tic Tac Toe can wait before each move
- Trade indicator goes away when you die or kill who you're fighting
- Anticheat: Scaffold no longer flags in lobbies or players who aren't bridging
- Holding Tab before the tab stats were ready no longer shows both tabs
- HUDs no longer start on top of each other
- Hover texts have proper margins, and long names end with "..." instead of being cut
- "1/4 zombies" and other games' requests no longer show as Bed Wars party requests
- Fixed a duplicate blacklist line in chat, and tab stats columns are tighter and aligned
- Fixed Studio exports failing with FFmpeg 8, and Studio is sharp on high DPI screens
- Spectate: cleaner chat for viewers and the map stays visible where the player walked away
- Fixed the Zeachify logo staying on your nametag after unloading
- Fixed bugs and improved performance
- & more!
